The '''Radiant One system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] portion of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dontamo]].
